name: dtsCore
description: The original DTS core (DTS Coherent Acoustics, up to 5.1 channels), converted to Apple Lossless for playback. The FFmpeg source is patched (third_party/patches/ffmpeg-0001-dts-core-only.diff) so that the `dca` decoder decodes only the core: the DTS-HD lossless (XLL) and DTS Express (LBR) decoders are not compiled and the extension parsers are removed. DTS-HD and DTS:X tracks play the DTS core they carry; DTS Express has none and does not play. Opt-in, in the `extended-plus` variant. Switched on by the app's owner on 2026-11-12 with the risk accepted, not after a lawyer's opinion (RESEARCH.md section 3.2, point 6).

dca.note: DTS core only (patched); a DTS licensing programme is believed active; the expiry of the core's patents is unverified
